name: MedBridge emergency fast-path labelled cases
description: Synthetic, hand-written patient messages labelled for the deterministic emergency classifier (medbridge/core/emergency_classifier.py). expected = "ESCALATE" or null. 'rules' lists rule ids that must be among matched_rules; 'negated' lists rule ids that must be reported as negated. Ambiguous phrasings are labelled ESCALATE (safety first) and explained in 'note'.
